summary: Faz-6.3 Runtime Skeleton complete testing. All 28 backend tests passed. Frontend /admin/strategies page runtime controls working correctly: Dispatch Runtime creates intents and emits events, Worker Run Once processes events idempotently, Hot/Cold trace stores functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Redis event bus envelope contains all required fields: event_id, event_type, correlation_id, causation_id, partition_key, created_at, schema_version, payload, payload_hash
Event types chain working: decision.produced -> execution.intent.created/rejected -> execution.order.submission_requested -> execution.order.submitted -> execution.order.updated/finalized
DecisionResult -> ExecutionIntent mapper: REJECT/HOLD no intent + rejected event, BUY/SELL/CLOSE creates immutable intent
ExecutionIntent immutability enforced via SQLAlchemy @event.listens_for(ExecutionIntent, 'before_update') raising ValueError('execution_intent_immutable')
Status transitions tracked via execution_intent_events table (event_type, event_status, external_order_id, payload)
Worker idempotency via PROCESSED_EVENTS_SET Redis set + is_event_processed/mark_event_processed functions
Paper/mock adapter boundary generates lifecycle states: NEW -> PARTIALLY_FILLED -> FILLED/CANCELED/REJECTED
DecisionTraceHot stores context_payload, decision_payload, intent_payload with 48-hour expires_at TTL
DecisionTraceCold stores lifecycle_summary and terminal_state after worker processes
InMemoryRedis fallback available when Redis unavailable

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All runtime controls working: Dispatch, Worker, Hot/Cold traces)

seed_data_creation: Multiple strategy definitions and intents created during testing (codes: faz63-test-*, reg-*, det-*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Faz-6.3 Runtime Skeleton features fully tested. Key behaviors verified: (1) Redis event bus contract with all required envelope fields, (2) Event types chain from decision.produced through finalized, (3) DecisionResult mapper creating intents for BUY/SELL/CLOSE only, (4) ExecutionIntent immutability with before_update blocker, (5) Worker idempotency via processed events set, (6) Paper adapter lifecycle states, (7) Hot/Cold trace storage, (8) Regression 6.1/6.2 endpoints still working. Runtime uses MOCKED paper exchange adapter by design.

event_bus_contract.ordering: Auto-incrementing via Redis INCR on runtime:events:ordering

event_types_chain.execution.intent.created: Emitted when BUY/SELL/CLOSE action creates intent
event_types_chain.execution.intent.rejected: Emitted for REJECT/HOLD actions with reason_codes
event_types_chain.execution.order.submission_requested: Emitted after intent created for worker processing
event_types_chain.execution.order.submitted: Emitted by worker after paper adapter submit

decision_to_intent_mapper.HOLD: No intent, emits execution.intent.rejected with hold_noop

execution_intent_immutability.enforcement: SQLAlchemy before_update event listener raises ValueError('execution_intent_immutable')
execution_intent_immutability.status_tracking: Via execution_intent_events table with event_type and event_status

endpoints.POST /api/strategy-domain/admin/runtime/: Dispatches decision to runtime bus, returns decision_result, execution_intent, emitted_events

paper_mock_adapter.submit_order: Generates deterministic lifecycle based on intent_hash seed

hot_cold_storage.hot_trace: Written on dispatch with 48-hour TTL via expires_at
hot_cold_storage.cold_trace: Written by worker with terminal_state and lifecycle_summary

mocked_api_note: Paper/mock exchange adapter intentionally used for runtime skeleton phase. No live exchange submit. Uses PaperExchangeAdapter class with deterministic lifecycle generation based on intent_hash seed.
